questions.q: Who was Timothy's grandmother, in whom faith lived first?
questions.evidence: which lived first in your grandmother Lois, and your mother Eunice, and, I am persuaded, in you also

questions.q: Endure hardship, Paul tells Timothy, as a good what?
questions.evidence: You therefore must endure hardship, as a good soldier of Christ Jesus

questions.q: What does Paul say every Scripture is?
questions.evidence: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness
